svg.title: OmniGet
svg.desc: Paste a link, get the file. OmniGet downloads courses, video, audio, images and torrents, then transcribes, converts, reads and studies them. One desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux.
svg.text: Courses, video, audio, images and torrents.
Then transcribe, convert, read and study. No terminal.
Free · open source · no account · files stay on your computer
